title: Ward of Your Own
hints: A hook is two parts: a command registered in .claude/settings.json, and whatever script that command actually runs. Neither exists here yet.
Register it under hooks.PreToolUse, matched on Bash, running `node .claude/hooks/guard.js` (or wherever you put it — the path just has to match).

The script reads JSON from stdin. If tool_input.command mentions diary.txt, append {"tool":"Hook","name":"ward-of-your-own"} to .claude-quest/hook.log and exit with code 2 to block it. Otherwise exit 0.
